# Province root. GUI supplies the native construction scopes.
rbhm_initialize = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { actor holder county character province founder owner duchy_slot special_slot }
	is_shown = {
		rbhm_context = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		rbhm_context = yes
		OR = { NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_0 } NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_1 } NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_2 } }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				rbhm_context = yes
				OR = { NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_0 } NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_1 } NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_2 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_0 }
				}
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_0 value = 0 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_0 value = 1 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_0 value = 2 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_0 value = 3 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_0 value = 4 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_0 value = 5 }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_1 }
				}
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_1 value = 0 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_1 value = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = rbhm_order_2 }
				}
				random_list = {
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_2 value = 0 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_2 value = 1 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_2 value = 2 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_2 value = 3 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_2 value = 4 }
					}
					
					1 = {
						set_variable = { name = rbhm_order_2 value = 5 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rbhm_menu = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { actor holder county character province founder owner duchy_slot special_slot }
	is_shown = {
		rbhm_menu_context = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		rbhm_menu_context = yes
	}
	effect = {
	
	}
}

rbhm_close = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { actor holder county character province founder owner duchy_slot special_slot }
	is_shown = {
		always = yes
	}
	is_valid = {
		always = yes
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = { remove_variable = rbhm_menu remove_variable = rbhm_menu_province }
	}
}

								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_piety multiply = -1 } }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_treasury > 0 } remove_treasury = scope:rbhm_pay_treasury }
							}
						}
					}
					
					if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:rbhm_selected_tower_of_silence_01
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_gold value = rbhm_price_tower_of_silence_01_gold }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_prestige value = rbhm_price_tower_of_silence_01_prestige }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_piety value = rbhm_price_tower_of_silence_01_piety }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_treasury value = rbhm_price_tower_of_silence_01_treasury }
						add_building = tower_of_silence_01
						if = {
							limit = {
								has_building = tower_of_silence_01
							}
							scope:actor = {
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_gold > 0 } remove_long_term_gold = scope:rbhm_pay_gold }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_prestige > 0 } add_prestige_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_prestige multiply = -1 } }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_piety multiply = -1 } }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_treasury > 0 } remove_treasury = scope:rbhm_pay_treasury }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					scope:actor = { set_variable = { name = rbhm_menu_province value = root } set_variable = { name = rbhm_menu value = flag:duchy } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

						if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_gold > 0 } remove_long_term_gold = scope:rbhm_pay_gold }

						if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_piety multiply = -1 } }

					}
					scope:actor = { remove_variable = rbhm_menu remove_variable = rbhm_menu_province }
				}

								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_treasury > 0 } remove_treasury = scope:rbhm_pay_treasury }
							}
						}
					}
					
					if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:rbhm_selected_mandala_capital_04
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_gold value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_04_gold }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_prestige value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_04_prestige }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_piety value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_04_piety }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_treasury value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_04_treasury }
						replace_building_effect = mandala_capital_04
						if = {
							limit = {
								has_building = mandala_capital_04
							}
							scope:actor = {
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_gold > 0 } remove_long_term_gold = scope:rbhm_pay_gold }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_prestige > 0 } add_prestige_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_prestige multiply = -1 } }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_piety multiply = -1 } }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_treasury > 0 } remove_treasury = scope:rbhm_pay_treasury }
							}
						}
					}
					
					if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:rbhm_selected_mandala_capital_05
						}
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_gold value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_05_gold }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_prestige value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_05_prestige }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_piety value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_05_piety }
						save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_treasury value = rbhm_price_mandala_capital_05_treasury }
						replace_building_effect = mandala_capital_05
						if = {
							limit = {
								has_building = mandala_capital_05
							}
							scope:actor = {
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_gold > 0 } remove_long_term_gold = scope:rbhm_pay_gold }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_prestige > 0 } add_prestige_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_prestige multiply = -1 } }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_piety multiply = -1 } }
								if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_treasury > 0 } remove_treasury = scope:rbhm_pay_treasury }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					scope:actor = { set_variable = { name = rbhm_menu_province value = root } set_variable = { name = rbhm_menu value = flag:great } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

rbhm_select_agot_great_fleet_01 = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { actor holder county character province founder owner duchy_slot special_slot }

		scope:actor = { var:rbhm_menu = flag:great }
		rbhm_idle = yes
		rbhm_pick_agot_great_fleet_01 = yes
		rbhm_afford_agot_great_fleet_01 = yes
	}
	effect = {
		show_as_tooltip = {
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_line_gold value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_gold }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_line_prestige value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_prestige }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_line_piety value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_piety }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_line_treasury value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_treasury }
			custom_tooltip = rbhm_line_agot_great_fleet_01
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					rbhm_menu_context = yes
					scope:actor = { var:rbhm_menu = flag:great }
					rbhm_idle = yes
					rbhm_pick_agot_great_fleet_01 = yes
					rbhm_afford_agot_great_fleet_01 = yes
				}
				save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_gold value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_gold }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_prestige value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_prestige }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_piety value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_piety }
				save_scope_value_as = { name = rbhm_pay_treasury value = rbhm_price_agot_great_fleet_01_treasury }
				add_great_building = agot_great_fleet_01
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_building = agot_great_fleet_01
					}
					scope:province.county = {
						add_county_modifier = {
							modifier = agot_build_great_fleet_engineers_modifier
							years = 15
						}
					}
					scope:province = {
						add_province_modifier = {
							modifier = agot_build_great_fleet_military_wharf_modifier
							years = 15
						}
					}
					scope:province.county = {
						add_county_modifier = {
							modifier = agot_build_great_fleet_merchant_quays_modifier
							years = 15
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_building = agot_great_fleet_01
					}
					scope:actor = {
						if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_gold > 0 } remove_long_term_gold = scope:rbhm_pay_gold }
						if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_prestige > 0 } add_prestige_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_prestige multiply = -1 } }
						if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = { value = scope:rbhm_pay_piety multiply = -1 } }
						if = { limit = { scope:rbhm_pay_treasury > 0 } remove_treasury = scope:rbhm_pay_treasury }
					}
					scope:actor = { remove_variable = rbhm_menu remove_variable = rbhm_menu_province }
				}
			}
		}
